body:

Your continued support fueled our campaign and created a community driven by the vision of a safer, more just Maryland. **Together, we have built a coalition united under our common goal to flip Maryland blue and create a safer state for all.** As we await the results of the election, I feel an overwhelming sense of hope and gratitude, knowing that we have built a movement ready to take bold action to tackle the biggest problems facing our state. I am so proud of the work we have done together, friend — _and I hope you are, too._ With gratitude, Doug

clean_body: Your continued support and faith fueled our campaign and created a community driven by the vision of a safer, more just Maryland. | As the polls close this evening, I want to take a moment to say thank you, friend. Your continued support fueled our campaign and created a community driven by the vision of a safer, more just Maryland. Together, we have built a coalition united under our common goal to flip Maryland blue and create a safer state for all. As we await the results of the election, I feel an overwhelming sense of hope and gratitude, knowing that we have built a movement ready to take bold action to tackle the biggest problems facing our state. I am so proud of the work we have done together, friend — and I hope you are, too. With gratitude, Doug By Authority: Friends of Doug Gansler, Terry Denney, Treasurer; Ana Sol Gutierrez, Chair. ### Tuesday, July 19th, 2022
Friend, The Republican Party of Minnesota is being disgraced by a Party Chair who is doing the dirt work for the Political Establishment. Alpha News published a piece this morning showing that the Party is working against some of its endorsed candidates. At least five grassroots conservative, Republican endorsed candidates had their Republican data system cut off by MNGOP Chairman Hann at a crucial moment before the August 9th Primary. Candidates Tom Dippel (Cottage Grove), Mark Bishofsky (Stillwater), Bill Lieske (Lonsdale), Natalie Barnes (Prior Lake) and Bret Bussman (Browerville) noticed their data access was locked out last Friday. name: John Fetterman
subject: Joe Manchin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Here’s a promise. If I get to the U.S. Senate, I’ll be 100% on board with saving our democracy.
#
Derek,
So it looks like Joe Manchin is yet another NO on Democrats’ plans.
I truly don't get it.
**Call me old fashioned, but I think Democrats should vote like Democrats. We don't need to be so concerned with how Republican senators will vote. We just need to vote for what’s right for the American people.**
I just want you to know... 🥰
**Send me to the U.S. Senate, I'll be 100% on board with saving our democracy.** I'll never base my vote on which way I think other senators are going to go. I'll just do what I know to be true.
Without flipping the Senate blue, we won't be able to scrap the filibuster + get things done. That makes winning Pennsylvania even more important.
[**_So, I'm asking for your help right now: Can you chip in your first $5 to help flip PA and save our democracy?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220719-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220719-6575&refcode2=6575_434096_zw69e0&akid=6575%2E434096%2Ezw69e0)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220719-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220719-6575&refcode2=6575_434096_zw69e0&akid=6575%2E434096%2Ezw69e0)**
I am truly, truly grateful for all the support you've given our campaign so far. If millions of people here in PA + across the country donate, volunteer and spread the word, I'm confident we will win. And when we do, I'll go to the Senate and fight for working people as hard as I can. I guarantee it.
Thanks for everything,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

Friend,

Democrat Tim Ryan is in a dead heat race for Ohio’s open Senate seat and
he needs our help.

You might not know this, but I was born into a blue-collar family in
Springfield, Ohio. My dad was a factory worker. My mom was a tailor. And I
got my start in music singing in the church choir.

I’ve never forgotten where I come from—I know the challenges Ohio families
are facing, because my family faced them too. That’s how I know Ohio needs
Tim Ryan in the Senate.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/17315?t=1010&amount=25&akid=4665%2E3611125%2EPwJXUw ]Republicans are spending millions and working overtime to defeat Tim.
Will you join me in supporting his campaign by making a contribution of
whatever you can to win this crucial race?

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/17315?t=1011&amount=25&akid=4665%2E3611125%2EPwJXUw ]Donate

There’s a real struggle happening in our country between love and
fear—between advancing civil rights for everyone or stripping them away,
between treating refugees with compassion or as criminals, between lifting
up working families or continuing to punish poverty.

[**HELP LEON SERVE THE PEOPLE!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=9ba9bc6561&e=3cd8121505) **I’m a Navy Combat Veteran, Small Business Owner, and Senior Pastor and Bishop at my church. name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2v14iktekkt8ellcn0j732echeo7kue3j4kogt8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbo78opiemp60p1lc9j69p3ncqpr8d5ledpj0sdlcoorcd5mm1rm6tr56pqj6stgsv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjadhgepgmcd776mqefc5lclp238h1e8he4933clgecp34c9gm9oh5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpplu4io6ceva7ie1qk7n11paavikk67qn8v4foo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zdnfgbm544t1jqbio4u6t2q135jkcd855c7f4ki8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmi6iqgig65h51uud6apo1e2p0q0ttl5pte1sabo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2za55gf1a450tjasoet7tfqlqh449hkun40dios68_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ziqrdfqpg8hbar2g0mnohvld7q0v8rmttragonv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj44vg1efi069cpot9qo01dccae7c6i80bs9u198_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ze9s1vesdqbscko558mefv9o9lvenibg7jasigk8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zh24ai4h6ijm01671dcbkpcif3btvrn6enpreej0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpghe88n0jqou86tek6iiafld7tctp0qf2do7m0g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0spi68oj1cjh2bs)**

I wasn't expecting was outright lies and falsehoods from fellow Republican candidates who, in their desperation to win, would resort to inventing lies out of thin air and spending hundreds of thousands of dollars to mislead voters. | | [](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/60493228:Wbgr_YhXN:m:1:2574580452:092A911BE301B4CE03C8DA25D733A7CC:r "Reagan Dunn for Congress")
---
|
Dear ,

I'm writing to you today because of an extremely troubling development in our race for the 8th Congressional District.

When I got into this race, I was prepared for the lies, false attacks, and malicious attempts to smear my character from the far left. What I wasn't expecting was outright lies and falsehoods from fellow Republican candidates who, in their desperation to win, would resort to inventing lies out of thin air and spending hundreds of thousands of dollars to mislead voters.

Unfortunately, candidate Jesse Jensen has done exactly that. He's spending an enormous amount of money lying about my record. I want to set the record straight and ask for your help spreading the word: **Jesse Jensen is lying to voters.**

Let's set the record straight. I'm the only candidate in this race who:
* Is endorsed by the _King County Police Officers Guild_ , _the Washington Council of Police and Sheriffs_ , _former King County Sheriff and Congressman Dave Reichert_ , and _Kittitas County Sheriff Clay Myers_ because I've fought - successfully - to **increase** police funding over the course of my time in the King County Council.
* Signed a pledge to not raise taxes in Congress.

Hello,
It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** An opportunity to come clean for my opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and tried to block a bipartisan commission from investigating the attack, still has yet to occur.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Senator Chuck Grassley because I place nation over baseless insurrection. It is a decision not entirely unlike the time of Lincoln. One does not serve the nation in military service to watch idly while it is dismembered by the likes of Donald Trump and his accomplices, to include Chuck Grassley.**
Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are raising boatloads to spend against me. I am the ultimate “hard target” for the Republicans, but to get elected, **I need your help. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs – instead, I’m relying entirely on grassroots donors _like you_.**

subject: We're just getting started

body:
Peter,
I can’t thank you enough.
Because of you, we won yesterday’s primary election and are one step closer to continuing our progress in Washington. When I say that it’s an honor to represent Maryland’s 6th District in Congress, I mean it.
Across the state, this primary was an important opportunity for Democrats to turn out and show how serious we are about winning in November. And we did just that when so many of you made your voices heard — and showed your commitment to electing leaders who value compassion, civility, and competence in government.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/4E7A446D53326A497A34386D4C766A36662F4F70494F6D6C75726D792F6754504979575A31573266706B6B4241306E3455307669417943647176786A612B6E59/editor_images/Primary%20Victory.png]
Our momentum is strong today. But we must keep it going. This can only be the beginning of our work.
Because Republicans showed their true colors yesterday, nominating an ultra-conservative Trump acolyte to run against me in November.
In his time in Annapolis, the main thing Neil Parrott has accomplished is building a reputation for ineffectiveness. He’s been named one of the least effective legislators in our state. Rather than getting results for his constituents, he’s focused on advocating for hate-filled policies — like requiring people with HIV to get tattoos, taking away rights from same-sex couples, and more.
I’ve beaten him before, and I know that I will do it again. But the truth is, it won’t be as easy this year — because national Republicans are backing him, and our district is more competitive this year.
That’s why your help is so important. This is not the time to sit on the sidelines. We need to maintain our momentum and work as hard as we can for the next four months. Our message is simple — when we work together, we get results. And when we lead with competence, compassion, and civility, we make progress and improve lives.
So today, let’s celebrate a little — and honor those who have worked tirelessly leading up to this election. And tomorrow, let’s get back to work and prepare to win big in November.
With gratitude,
David

Shortly after the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , I appeared on MSNBC's Morning Joe to discuss the implications of this dreadful decision for women and girls in Georgia.

**[If you have a few minutes, I hope you can watch my interview. And then, please chip in a few dollars or more to help me defeat an anti-choice attorney general and fight for the basic healthcare rights of Georgians →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48069486/356810100/-487690556?refcode=EM_FR_220720MJ_N_JJ_OB_8_G_N_L2&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTY5ZDY5Ni0zYTA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tkIenX209yMjwsQye77-qWP9uJrTozlLCcAxdilS4Ow=)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48069487/356810101/-487690556?refcode=EM_FR_220720MJ_N_JJ_OB_8_G_N_P1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTY5ZDY5Ni0zYTA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tkIenX209yMjwsQye77-qWP9uJrTozlLCcAxdilS4Ow=) This fight is about people like my daughter — who's about to be in a world where she has fewer rights than I did at her age. All the restrictive laws and soundbites that we see from extreme politicians right now are completely incongruent with the lives that women deserve to lead and the private decisions they should be able to make for themselves.

HB 481 (Georgia's six-week abortion ban that I fought against in 2019) will likely go into effect by August. The consequences will be stark.

Georgia already has the highest maternal mortality rate in the country, and further cutting off women from reproductive care will do nothing but increase this rate and perpetuate inequalities across the state.

I grew up in a poor community in rural Georgia, and I've been thinking about how folks in communities like mine will disproportionately feel the impact of this Supreme Court decision. I understand how this ruling and the implementation of HB 481 will impact women of _all_ backgrounds. **They need an Attorney General who will fight for them, not against them.**

Georgia Republicans (including my opponent, Chris Carr) are making life-saving care less accessible and the quality of living worse for countless people. We need to stop them in November, up and down the ballot.

[**Please support my campaign, and then share my recent interview with a friend — everyone needs to know what's at stake.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48069488/356810102/-487690556?refcode=EM_FR_220720MJ_N_JJ_OB_8_G_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTY5ZDY5Ni0zYTA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tkIenX209yMjwsQye77-qWP9uJrTozlLCcAxdilS4Ow=)

Thank you,

Jen | | | **Democratic State Senator Jen Jordan (pronounced Jer-Dun) has spent her legal career fighting for Georgians. Using fist bumps to get Saudi oil to supplement the lack of supply created by his own misplaced policy is about as tone deaf as you can get and it is painfully insulting to the hard-working energy workers who Biden put out of business.

We have every opportunity to go back to being energy independent here in the U.S., and yet Biden is reaching out to Saudi Arabia for help. The American people deserve better.

name: John King
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by John King for Governor, Eliza Leighton, Treasurer John King for Governor
body:
| | | Peter, When I entered this race, I did so for the same reasons I became an educator. Losing both my parents to illness at such a young age, I know what it’s like to feel alone in the world and like no one has your back. But I also know how the right support from the right public institutions can save lives – I’m living proof. If it wasn’t for the public school educators who nurtured me and gave me a second chance, I wouldn’t be here today. I became an educator because I wanted to make sure students had the same life saving opportunities I did. I got into public service because I know firsthand that in our society there are too many systemic barriers holding people back. This race for governor has always been deeply personal to me because I know there are too many Maryland families that have been denied real opportunity. **While we do not yet know who will be our Democratic nominee, sadly we know at this point it will not be us.** I want to thank the tens of thousands of supporters, donors, volunteers and activists who’ve supported this movement every step of the way and shared our belief that state government can and should be a force for good in people’s lives. I am profoundly grateful for my running mate Michelle Siri’s leadership on behalf of economic dignity for Maryland families and for her tireless fight to not only protect every Marylander’s bodily autonomy, but to also guarantee a safe haven for the thousands of out-of-state women seeking abortion care. I want to thank my family who joined me on the campaign trail and sacrificed so much to go on this journey with me. I feel incredibly blessed to have my wife Melissa as a partner in all things - and could not be more proud of my daughters Amina and Mireya. While these results are disappointing, I am tremendously proud of the campaign we have run. We showed that progressive Democrats can campaign in every corner of this state. We showed that those who are too often ignored by Annapolis insiders need to be heard. Whether it’s the voices of the incarcerated as Maryland continues to struggle with being the state with the highest rate of incarceration of Black men, trans Marylanders who have been denied gender affirming health care, or the education support professionals who are long overdue for a raise, we never compromised and never equivocated on our core principles. From universal, affordable child care to Medicare for All, from committing to net-zero emissions by 2035 to a transportation approach centered on people not cars, we have lifted up a vision for a more just and prosperous Maryland. I am proud of the people that came together to help fight for a brighter, more equitable future. While we may not have been victorious, Michelle and I will never stop fighting alongside you. My great-grandparents lived with a faith in a future they could not see. A future where in three generations their family could go from being enslaved in a cabin in Gaithersburg to serving in the cabinet of the first Black president. **Now we too must live with faith in a future we might not be able to see today, but it’s a future we know is possible. We know it’s possible because on this campaign we helped lift the voices of those too often ignored.** Thank you so much for your support, and I wish the best of luck to the next Democratic nominee. With eternal gratitude,
John B. King Jr.

These are horrifying times. If we’ve learned anything over the past year and a half, it’s that we can’t just elect _any_ Democrat to Congress–we need to elect the right kind of Democrats. Representatives who will be strong, unwavering champions for fundamental rights like abortion and marriage equality.

An interview with Mondaire’s primary opponent, conservative Democrat Dan Goldman, revealed that he supports limiting abortion rights to a timeline similar to extreme right-wing “viability” abortion bans.
Another challenger in the race, Councilmember Carlina Rivera, stated to the same publication that she would consider religious exemptions to LGBTQ+ rights.
I know what you’re thinking. What the hell is happening?
**Here’s what we know: Mondaire is a pro-choice, pro-equality champion who voted to pass the _Women’s Health Protection Act_ and the _Equality Act_ in the House. He also courageously introduced legislation to expand the Supreme Court to protect abortion and LGBTQ+ rights from the far-right Supreme Court.**
Team, at a time when our fundamental rights are under assault across the country, we need strong progressive champions in Congress and there is no room for folks in Washington who will waver in the fight to protect those rights and defend marginalized communities.
**The choice is clear.**

The Secretaries of State elected this year will be the people deciding who wins the presidency in 2024. During the shocking Jan. 6th hearings, we found that Donald Trump, Mark Meadows, Ted Cruz, Josh Hawley and dozens of House members, state legislators, governors and other officials told the deadly lie that Donald Trump won the election enough times that it inspired people to commit acts of vandalism, violence and treason. Two of these individuals, de-programmed, as if from a cult, talked about why they attacked the Capitol on January 6th, 2020, why they were there, what they believed, and what they intended to do. And it all came down to one very simple fact: If they had not been lied to by Republicans day in and day out--the very Republicans who are still inciting riot every day by lying about this election--then January 6th would not have happened. A dozen or so House members were revealed to have met with Donald Trump to plan the coup, likely leading to criminal liability for them. Yet, some of them and various other GOP officials are now running for positions where they will have control of state election machinery. For example, one of these coup plotters, Jody Hice of Georgia, was running for Secretary of State (SoS) in a primary vs Republican Brad Raffensberger, who stood up to Trump's calls for stealing votes. | | | | | | Luckily, Hice lost in the primary. But we weren't so lucky in other states. Some primaries have not yet taken place, and in some states, Republicans who claim Trump won the 2020 election are their party's nominee. We must defeat these democracy arsonists if we are to keep our democratic republic. The Democratic Association of Secretaries of State helps elect Democrats Secretary of State in all states where this is an electoral position. We absolutely must help them if we're to prevent Republicans who perverted our electoral process in 2020--but failed to overthrow our government--from succeeding when they inevitably try the same exact thing in 2024. If we let these fascistic Republican lunatics win this important position in key states, we're as good as done. Thank you so much for protecting our elections. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWHJqqYhXN

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWHJqqYhXN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

In less than two weeks, it'll be Primary Day in Washington. This is our first real chance to fight for our freedoms at the ballot box and continue our fight for a democracy that works for the people.

I've already dropped off my ballot, but if you haven't yet -- make sure to drop your ballot off before 8 p.m. on August 2! **[You can find your drop box location here.](https://act.myngp.com/el/IEkm6e5i4phJO9jO4OCYW_qCaYE-Ck1BkMUV0C7TMuc=/MsflNnwqTcV25X1yvyTHxb1PglMky0T_PyFZMYSulj0=)**

The deadline to update your voter registration status online and by mail is next Monday, July 25. **[Make sure you're registered and ready to vote by checking your voter registration status right now.](https://act.myngp.com/el/IEkm6e5i4phJO9jO4OCYW_qCaYE-Ck1BkMUV0C7TMuc=/0e4LVuugUpnHOr9JOfIg0VHVUAzL0mV4025VlWhSHAg=)** You can still register to vote in person during business hours and any time before 8 p.m. on Election Day.

Peter, I'm committed to helping people in our area who are struggling, but I can't do this important work alone. I ask for your vote, so we can continue to help folks in our community, stand up for reform, and get our government working for the people.

These past few months prove the future of reproductive freedom, voting rights, the economy, and our environment is on the line. It's crucial you make your voice heard loud and clear this year -- for our region and for our future.

Our grassroots movement has been leading up to this moment, so please, **[double and triple-check your registration before the July 25 deadline.](https://act.myngp.com/el/IEkm6e5i4phJO9jO4OCYW_qCaYE-Ck1BkMUV0C7TMuc=/0e4LVuugUpnHOr9JOfIg0VHVUAzL0mV4025VlWhSHAg=)**

Derek

| | | Team, **I want to say the most heartfelt THANK YOU for supporting our campaign.** To all the people who voted for me, to all the volunteers who knocked doors and made calls, to all the grassroots supporters who helped us build this movement from the ground up. **While the end result didn't go in our favor – congratulations to Congressman Hoyer on a 22nd term in office – this is a movement bigger than any one person or one election.** It's a movement to put people-funded and people-centered candidates in office up and down the ballot. I plan to take some time to figure out my next steps, but I do know that I'm not going anywhere. I'm going to keep organizing, keep advocating, and keep fighting here in Maryland for racial, economic, and environmental justice. There's too much at stake to stop. And because this is a movement bigger than just any one person, I want to share some good news with you from last night too: Ashley Esposito, a longtime organizer with our organization dedicated to ending the school-to-prison pipeline Schools Not Jails, is currently leading in the FIRST-EVER Baltimore City School Board Election. I’ll be doing what I can to help her win in November – because it’s time for some damn change. In solidarity, with love and gratitude, Mckayla

| | Hello, Public education today is failing our nation's young people-and their parents. As each generation moves on from the public school system, more and more Americans are growing unaware of our country's great history and civic traditions. But unfortunately, civics and history are too often forgotten or overlooked in the 21st century. That's why I am committed to having conversations with thought leaders around the country and providing educational resources for Americans. But an educated citizenry is essential to self-government-and the future of freedom. That's why I've issued a challenge to patriots like you to read-or re-read-the Declaration of Independence as part of our More Perfect Union Project. Because this important historical document is so rich with wisdom and eternal truths, I've asked my team at ACI to put together a helpful guide that offers a clear and exclusive analysis of this piece of history. [And I'm emailing you today to make sure you get a free copy of this latest eBook: _Breaking Down the Declaration_. ](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1icmVha2luZ19kb3duX3RoZV9kZWNsYXJhdGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRV9GRk8wNzIwMjAyMiJ9/Bc4lHMG2V_bT5KqkXGwJsw) [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1icmVha2luZ19kb3duX3RoZV9kZWNsYXJhdGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRV9GRk8wNzIwMjAyMiJ9/et3QsrNn9XcmgATph3K-RQ)
When you read this book, you’ll discover:
* The historical context surrounding the Declaration of Independence and why our Founders drafted it
* The 3 essential elements of the Declaration and what they meant for the establishment of our nation
* How many of King George’s original offenses are being repeated by our own government today

You can get your free copy using this secure link: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/breaking-down-the-declaration/](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1icmVha2luZ19kb3duX3RoZV9kZWNsYXJhdGlvbiZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRV9GRk8wNzIwMjAyMiJ9/iySzGz3gXPp3eaJMtMPLHQ) And I hope you'll share it with your family, friends, and anyone you know in our younger generations. If we're going stop history from repeating itself, it is critical that we educate as many people as possible. I really hope you enjoy this book. I love summer in New Hampshire, friend.

From drives along Ocean Boulevard to Independence Day parades across the state to enjoying an ice cream cone, the Granite State has an awful lot to offer.

But summer also means a drop in our fundraising. And understandably so – people are spending more time outdoors, not focusing on politics.
I get it.

But let me explain why we can't lose our momentum, especially now.
1. While most of us are spending time with family and friends, extreme GOP groups are spending over $21 million on attack ads against me.

2\. A public poll shows me down two points to an anti-choice Republican.

3\. With the Senate split 50-50, losing here means losing our Democratic majority, paving the way for Mitch McConnell's extreme, anti-choice agenda.

| Peter-
By now, I am sure you have seen a rumor spreading around social media that myself - and 148 other Republicans - voted to kick unvaccinated service members out of the military.
That's a lie. Period.
There wasn't a vote on vaccines. The grifters spreading this lie don't even reference a specific bill or provision in a bill, which should be your first clue that it's BS.
What they're actually referring to is the NDAA - the National Defense Authorization Act, which the House passed last week. Problem is, the only thing in the NDAA that even references vaccine status does the *exact opposite* of what these people are claiming.
The NDAA extends the PROHIBITION against dishonorable discharges for service members who don't take the vaccine and requires the Defense Secretary to standardize the religious and administrative vaccine exemption process across services so there is uniformity.
Moreover, the NDAA also directs the Defense Secretary to brief Congress regularly on the impact the vaccine mandate is having on recruitment and retention. And this bill furthers our readiness so our military has the resources necessary to defend the United States, which is really what the people spreading these rumors are mad about. They don't want to fund the military, which makes them no different than the Bernie bros.
They're liars starving for clicks and attention. Don't give it to them. Virtually every Republican who voted for the NDAA is vehemently against kicking service members out of the military for their COVID vaccine status, including and especially myself. That's the truth.
Pay close attention to the people you saw spreading this lie. They knew it wasn't true. They are not conservatives, and have more in common with the far left than they do with Reagan conservatives. They want to tear it all down, and that includes the United States military. They believe the best way to do that is to infiltrate the Republican Party and transform it from within, and they do so by taking advantage of many people's skepticism of mainstream media and politicians. There's no principles or values they abide by, except for rank contrarianism. Why? Because that's the quickest path to gaining attention on social media. Conservatives should stop falling for it, and expel these grifters from the movement.
Most politicians wouldn't even bother addressing rumors and lies spread about them online... they just ignore it and hope it goes away on its own. But by now you have obviously realized that I am not like other politicians.
When people lie about my voting record or smear my name, I fight back fiercely. I confront these attacks head-on. I give my supporters - people like you - the counterpoints to refute the false narratives that are spread about myself and other conservative Republicans by grifters who wear the "red jersey" but know nothing about conservative ideals and do nothing to further the conservative cause.
And when you donate to my campaign, your hard-earned money doesn't just sit in a "war chest." It is put to immediate use, growing our movement with events like my annual Youth Summit, persuading more people to join the Republican Party, and electing strong conservatives in the swing seats we need to win to give us a governing majority.
I am not going to change. I am not going to bow to the mob. And I will not shy away from confronting lies with the truth, regardless of which side is spreading those lies.

These FEC deadlines can work in our favor, but they can also work against us:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=683%2E61531%2EohrF1m)
Team,
Tonight is our final FEC filing deadline before the primary election on August 9, which means it’ll be one of our last opportunities to show our grassroots strength both to undecided voters and Peter’s opponents in this Senate race.
These numbers go public, so it’s important we put forth a strong performance on Peter’s behalf. The GOP has already put us on notice that they’ll be watching Vermont very closely—the last thing we want to do is give Mitch McConnell and his cronies confidence they can win here as election season ramps up.
[**It is essential we elect a progressive Democrat to the Senate and keep Mitch McConnell from wreaking havoc as Majority Leader. If you’re able, please make a $5 donation to Peter Welch’s Senate campaign ahead of tonight’s FEC deadline.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3496?t=3&akid=683%2E61531%2EohrF1m)

If our numbers are strong, that’s a great indicator that we’re in a solid position to meet our budget targets and help Peter win this important Senate seat. But if they’re lagging behind, it could spur the GOP to work even harder—and invest millions of special interest cash—to flip this seat red.
That’s why this final push ahead of tonight’s deadline is so crucial. We’ve already seen what Mitch McConnell as Majority Leader looks like, and it’s hard to imagine a progressive future for our country if it happens again.

[**We could really use your help between now and tonight’s fundraising deadline. Rush a $5 gift or anything you can spare and see to it that Peter Welch becomes Vermont’s next senator.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3496?t=7&akid=683%2E61531%2EohrF1m)

body:
Vedat Gashi Secures Westchester Elected Women Officials' Endorsements
## Borgia, Galef, Paulin, Williams & Walter Support NY 16 Democratic Congressional Primary Campaign

######
[Lloyd Trufelman, Community Contributor](https://act.myngp.com/el/le3SJZsNvxiNx3tElf9wd3eyP1j1Gnf3co7ZeOTSGLs=/WHt6Unw0SGRfGdIuGdgY7TwP667ivJeBfqBUZqPv89k=)
Posted Wed, Jul 20, 2022 at 12:31 pm ET

Westchester County Legislator Vedat Gashi, Candidate for Congress (Gashiforcongress.com)
A distinguished group of elected women officials at various levels across Westchester County have endorsed [Vedat Gashi](https://act.myngp.com/el/le3SJZsNvxiNx3tElf9wd3eyP1j1Gnf3co7ZeOTSGLs=/Iv4yTSkGwuyxN8WpnCVfheVIek2lRuD3azSQNW8VMFc=) in the August 23 Democratic congressional primary for NY 16, confirming that Gashi's experience, expertise and track record of public service make him highly qualified to hold the office.
The initial group of women officials includes Westchester Country Board of Legislators Chair Catherine Borgia (Ossining, Briarcliff, Croton, Cortlandt, Peekskill), NYS Assemblywoman Sandy Galef (Cortland, Ossining, Peekskill); NYS Assemblywoman Amy Paulin (Bronxville, Eastchester, New Rochelle, Pelham, Tuckahoe, White Plains); and former Westchester County Legislators Alfreda Williams and Ruth Walter. Additional endorsements will be forthcoming.
"I am honored to accept the support of these Westchester women leaders," says Gashi, who currently serves as a Westchester County legislator. "Since first being elected, I've had the opportunity to work with them in various capacities on different legislation, including the recent passage of the county's [Reproductive Health Care Facilities Access Act](https://act.myngp.com/el/le3SJZsNvxiNx3tElf9wd3eyP1j1Gnf3co7ZeOTSGLs=/iJSw8CYSnLtF6eob8BhG9bfcV0AnvkoGQq1Lvyp2xLA=), and I look forward to building on these relationships to deliver results for all of NY 16's residents".
"Our campaign is dedicated to delivering real progress for everyday New Yorkers and ensuring that everyone has a shot at the American dream, Gashi adds, noting that he will "fight to protect working families and expand the middle class, because this district deserves a representative who supports mainstream Democratic policies and values who will put progress before posturing and work hard to get things done".
[New York's 16th congressional district](https://act.myngp.com/el/le3SJZsNvxiNx3tElf9wd3eyP1j1Gnf3co7ZeOTSGLs=/sie6OkPgTaaA70pRD5xqz4LsLL9jmEEd5pI2Wb59qLs=?districtType=cd&propA=current_2012&propB=congress_specialmastermay20_20220520&selected=-73.769,40.942) for the United States House of Representatives includes part of the northern Bronx and the southern half of Westchester County, including the cities of Mount Vernon, New Rochelle, Rye, White Plains and Yonkers.

Peter --

I wanted to make sure you saw the news that our race was added to the House Democrats’ "Red to Blue" program. If you don’t know, “Red to Blue” is reserved for the strongest candidates running in critical districts that we must hold in order to keep House control.

This is proof that we are in a strong position to flip this seat.

**Ken Calvert has had no choice but to acknowledge our momentum, and in typical Calvert fashion, he's using it as an opportunity to further divide our community. In a recent fundraising email to donors, Calvert disparaged “Democrats in Palm Springs” and sounded the alarm about their efforts to defeat him.**

As a reminder, Palm Springs is in Calvert’s district. _These are voters he’s running to represent._ Instead of earning their trust, he’s casting them as villains to raise money. It’s a play straight from the Trump playbook, and it’s no wonder the former president endorsed him.

This type of hyperpartisanship is _exactly_ why I decided to run in the first place. We can’t address any issues seriously by vilifying the people we’re supposed to represent. The good news is that we now have our BEST CHANCE to hold Calvert accountable at the ballot box.

We can win this race, but I’ll need your help to do it:

We will have to use their gerrymandered map this cycle. **** This graphic from political scientist David Pepper shows why the GOP is willing to go against the state Constitution to gerrymander: they can use it to sway election outcomes in their favor.

body:
Data released by the CDC last week says that nearly 49,000 people were killed by guns in 2021.
#

Friends -
Data released by the CDC last week indicates that nearly 49,000 people were killed by guns in 2021.
That number absolutely shatters the previous record, set in 2020.
It’s a staggering number to wrap our heads around.
That is 49,000 parents, children, sisters, brothers, friends, co-workers that were lost to tragedies we know how to prevent.
It is 49,000 sets of families, friends and loved ones whose lives are forever changed because of gun violence.
Here are some more numbers for you to consider:
The gun death rate increased 15% from 2019 to 2020.
Now the gun death rate has increased by another 8% from 2020 to 2021.
These numbers demonstrate the scale of our nation’s gun violence crisis and the urgent need for additional action, including universal background checks for gun sales.
We will not stop until it happens.
Lives are on the line.
Thank you for reading,
The team at Giffords

| , Newsom was out of state (yet again) just last week in DC, receiving a national award for California’s transformative improvements to education.

Let’s take a closer look at what ‘transformative improvements’ have been made in California’s schools over the last 4 years.

•**California ranks nearly dead last in K-12 Education (41st out of 50).

• California’s students are currently ranked last when it comes to literacy.

• 63% of students said they’d had an emotional meltdown in 2021.

• 22% of students said they’d missed three or more days of school due to mental health.

• 19% of our children reported suicidal thoughts.**

Tell me, why is our Governor accepting an award based on these results? He prides himself on allocating unprecedented funding to our students, but clearly the results are in–he is failing our children.

We cannot allow this man (who is bought off by the teachers’ union) to continue to ruin our state for another four years. Your children deserve better.

It’s clearly time for change.

It’s time to rebuild the Californian dream.

Again, we need your help to make it across the November finish line.

Just 10,033 votes (0.2 percentage points) decided Florida's last Senate race – so I'll tell you the plain truth: **I cannot win this without you.** [**That's why I'm asking you to become one of the donors to my campaign for Senate by splitting a contribution between me and Serve America right now. Every dollar you can spare will help us build the strongest grassroots operation to defeat Rubio, flip Florida blue and defend our Senate majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48081399/356861296/-74008005?refcode=20220720_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NGVjODZjMy01ODA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rHK_nCnZ8BBFtcbIp6jT9D3f2Tof5AAW03rtZZWDXC4=) Every day, I carry with me that I am a descendent of enslaved people, people who knew that they would not make it, but dreamed and prayed that one day I would. Their prayers carried me to this day – carried me through a life of public service as a social worker, as a law enforcement officer, the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's police chief, and as the proud representative of Florida's 10th Congressional district. **So hear me when I say this: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the ’60s, have an amazing story of opportunity like mine.** The prayers of my parents propel me forward, even now, giving me the strength and courage it takes to do what's right. To impeach and prosecute a corrupt president. To never stop fighting for gun safety reform. To push for truth, accountability, justice. [**I stand on the side of our democratic institutions, on the side of everyday working Floridians – but I need your help to win this race. Will you split a contribution of $20 or more to Serve America and me to defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48081400/356861297/-74008005?refcode=20220720_Demings&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NGVjODZjMy01ODA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rHK_nCnZ8BBFtcbIp6jT9D3f2Tof5AAW03rtZZWDXC4=) In my decades of public service, I've worked with some truly incredible individuals – champions of civil rights like my friend John Lewis, who said, "Each generation must do its part to create an even more fair, more just society." Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. subject: Save the American dream 💪
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRCC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
|

---
| | | Peter, this is Young Kim. I'm a small business owner, mom, and one of the first Korean-American women elected to Congress. Only in America is a story like mine possible, and it's why I'm fighting to protect the American Dream for every family.

As a young girl, my family left Korea in search of the American Dream in a country that promises opportunity for all. I attended college here, built a small business here, and eventually served as the first South Korean born woman elected to the California state legislature where I stood up to the country's **most Far-Left politicians.**

**When I saw Democrats in Washington pushing Far-Left, California-style policies, I knew I couldn 't sit back and let it happen.**

I ran for Congress - and I won. I promised my constituents and all Americans that I would fight the Democrats' efforts to impose their progressive agenda nationwide.

It hasn't been easy. The agenda Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi support is crushing the American Dream. Our border is unsecure, families face higher prices, and crime is out of control in our cities.

subject: Ballots Have Dropped. It's Time to Vote!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Peggy Schiller
body:
Ballots are already in the hands of voters! It's time to decide who you will choose to represent you. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3955e7cefafb/ballots-have-dropped-its-time-to-vote?e=9c22e4067b)
---
| |
---
| | Hello Peter,

While the primary election is just over one month away, **voting has already begun!**

First and foremost - **are you registered?** **You have until Monday, July 25th** to register to vote before the primary.

---
| [Check Your Registration >](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=62e3697ce7&e=9c22e4067b "Check Your Registration >")
---
| Ballots have been sent to voters who have already requested a vote-by-mail ballot.

**It's not too late to request your vote-by-mail ballot.** You may do so up until August 13th, but don't procrastinate - **request your ballot today!**

---
| [Request Vote-By-Mail Ballot >](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=d5b041e41d&e=9c22e4067b "Request Vote-By-Mail Ballot >")
---
| I want to take a minute to remind you exactly who you'll be voting for should you cast your vote for me:
* A candidate passionate about **protecting our environment** , **addressing climate change** , and **stopping environmental racism** caused by pollution
* A devoted, experienced **advocate for civil rights, voting rights, women's rights and equality**
* A believer in keeping our promises to veterans, active duty military, and their families, **prioritizing bringing a VA hospital to our district**
* A **protector of Medicare and Social Security** , ensuring seniors are taken care of in their golden years
* An enforcer who will **reign in unfettered development, enforce housing laws, and facilitate the growth of affordable housing options**
* A Congresswoman who will **govern with common sense, dignity, honesty and integrity** by listening to her constituents and their needs

---
| **The First Congressional District is ripe for change.** We've seen enough of spotlight-driven candidates fueled by interests outside of the Panhandle. **Let's keep this election local.**

Choose the candidate who has been a homeowner in the Panhandle for nearly a decade, who has volunteered and advocated on behalf of voters here for years, and who has forged meaningful relationships with constituents, neighbors, and leaders in our district.

If you haven't had an opportunity to talk to me, meet me, or learn about me yet, I encourage you to reach out. **I'd love to hear what your priorities are** and how I can best represent you.

---
| [Learn More About Peggy >](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=b61597ea8a&e=9c22e4067b "Learn More About Peggy >")
---
| As we enter the homestretch into the primary, **we are counting on the support of voters like you** to help fuel our efforts through August 23rd and into the general election.

If you are able, we hope you'll chip in even a few dollars to help drive our ground game through the primary and beyond.

---
| [Donate Today >](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=1dd5968450&e=9c22e4067b "Donate Today >")
---
| The method in which you vote doesn't matter - by mail, early voting, or in person on election day. But **by all means VOTE**.

Now more than ever, it is so important to **make sure your voice is heard**.

And **I sincerely hope to earn your vote this August and again in November**. It would be my honor to represent the First Congressional District.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | [](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=6feb14580b&e=9c22e4067b)

If we don’t act now, the problem will only get worse. It’s time to give teachers the resources they deserve to give our students the education they deserve.

[_Chip in $10 right now to help us elect pro-education candidates in TN that will tackle this crisis head-on. →_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48082142/356864003/1141538894?refcode=EM_FR_220720Teachers_N_TBT_90DO180DC_6_NG_TESTB_l1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTNlNjY0OC01YzA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a_yLKB-wSYqWccTCtNoD9RNcBSPycWosWAL9iGlNQ6o=)** [CHIP IN $10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48082143/356864004/1141538894?refcode=EM_FR_220720Teachers_N_TBT_90DO180DC_6_NG_TESTB_B1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTNlNjY0OC01YzA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a_yLKB-wSYqWccTCtNoD9RNcBSPycWosWAL9iGlNQ6o=) Peter, you probably saw the news that Middle Tennessee alone is facing over 1,000 vacancies for teachers in the upcoming school year. This didn’t happen overnight. This is what happens after years of chronically underpaying our educators. Teachers are highly educated professionals with many of them obtaining 2 or more degrees. Yet many educators take on 2 or 3 jobs, night shifts, and more _just to make ends meet._

Her victories in combating climate change include establishing an Energy Director position and the Office of Sustainability, funding flood control projects, encouraging investment in renewable energies, and reducing local governments; carbon footprint. She’s made the acute connection between social justice and environmental policy and has successfully passed legislation that has saved taxpayers’ money and kept our air and water clean.
Just last week, the Westchester County Board of Legislators unanimously passed a bill she authored, the Westchester County Flood History Disclosure law. The Detroit news reported last week:
---
---

---
---
In fact, these Leftists are petrified, as they should be.
No scheming will stop the grassroots from electing a Governor who will put an end to shenanigans, and restore freedom to Michigan.
You will continue to see lawsuits, as the Democrats desperately try to keep me off the ballot.
Do not be dismayed or disturbed.
The Democrats will throw everything they have at me, including money from big donors.
It's not going to work.

---
Peter, It’s no secret that election integrity was at an all-time low in 2020. Left-wing activists put pressure on weak-spined politicians and judges to radically change election laws and make them less secure. In 2020, ballots were indiscriminately mailed out. There were unsecured and unmonitored dropboxes. And laws about when ballots must be returned were challenged or just ignored.
Preserving free and fair elections is the most important issue. **Heritage Action knew something must be done!**

For 18 months, our activists have worked to change state laws and get rid of unsecure Covid-era voting rules. It was all part of our successful Save Our Elections campaign. We strengthened voter ID laws. We got rid of ballot trafficking. And when states did use ballot dropboxes, we insisted on making sure they are monitored and secured. [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=54dd8a0dd71c4c5caca5f433cad7e76a&_e=hmetPyu27JUD0xjNo2LaxM-QxeAkD_T4LLO2DguWUoE3qkEtfq8D4qYr7HowqOUhPiiQZ9-ymvURqgA7SeX-GN3lzpYWm_JTQOF5-xXNDVnhBYaeoNYsLqRkz_syF7eR3tLraV7tc0ma7RwVkDEApTi9AkKUpy8SPPyOoU9wE_ZuV2CjgGIpmCwxnrRQb1g__xaXbyUz33PWBc6LAKIsuB-JwWt6bhYiYmkb4np6k2IuxVo8Ea2T7X2_mQbgtbQDbaZste-4kFIwRGm0iaZxb7nm0RwTcOmFYNnIczADnFT_fjvNW3ALZdswkHpTIf-CDFwzTbjgH0QT3Ao6dSumYu9s_w9PxtLkhWGoLoD8L6m9SnIDefV1aeStLUM5jLlZlPCsKIRzuoLbEJRTPH-CB9hBH-zkx161zjy5FniYqIA_foipaY0ZI7XdneKLL69KpvaldR8jE4RoAWMRSO1UqN-DF9GnItGD2jRsT9_qOHBRcw_h2L3oFgsIko7O3Kl4)

---
Fellow American,

The news last week for our campaign was a mixed bag.

While we raised the most money last quarter of any non-incumbent Republican running for the Senate in the country, **our opponent raised $11 million more than us and has three times as much money in the bank.**

That's why I think it's sad he emails far-Left donors and _**falsely warns**_ them he may have to take his ads off TV because he doesn't have enough money to compete.

**In reality, our campaign is the one that cannot keep up with his record-setting fundraising machine of out-of-state money.**

Dr. Jason Martin

| | | Peter,

I'm currently at the Fort Peck Tribal Court 1st Annual Human Trafficking Conference to discuss strategies to stop human trafficking and how to combat the Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women, Girls, and Two-Spirit People crisis, so I thought I'd send out this important message.

As a tenacious advocate for survivors of human trafficking, I cofounded the Yellowstone County Area Human Trafficking Task Force, the largest such task force in Montana.

I have secured funding from the Montana Legislature for additional state agents to investigate human trafficking crimes, co-authored bills to strengthen laws on human trafficking, participated in national committees developing policy on crimes of human trafficking and child sexual abuse material, often referred to as child pornography, and, in 2020, I was the lone Montanan invited to attend the White House Summit on Human Trafficking.

[__**Will you chip in $50 right now to help me stop human trafficking in Congress?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=5d8a46afb5&e=2f4ec52c5e)

It's safe to say I know what I'm talking about when it comes to stopping human trafficking. __**Now, I'm not sure I can say the same thing for my opponent, Matt Rosendale.**__
---
| [ ](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=65e98fecd4&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
WATCH: Penny Ronning fights human traffickers and WINS
| As a state legislator, Matt Rosendale was one of only 7 state senators to __**vote against strengthening Montana’s human trafficking laws**__ by allowing survivors an affirmative defense, deeming a survivor's past sexual behavior generally inadmissible, and requiring perpetrators to register as sex offenders.

It gets worse.

In 2015, Rosendale voted against expanding unemployment insurance availability for survivors of domestic violence.

In 2011, Rosendale voted against funding an expansion of a sex crime survivor notification system that tells survivors when their perpetrator gets out of prison. The system would have encompassed 8,400 more felons.

ALL Montanans deserve a Congress member who cares more about protecting THEM - not human traffickers and sex offenders.

[__**Can I count on you to chip in $50 so I can bring the fight to end human trafficking to Congress?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=df4e0bc7b8&e=2f4ec52c5e)

Thank you and together we rise!

clean_body: Read This Important Message; I'm currently at the Fort Peck Tribal Court 1st Annual Human Trafficking Conference. | | | | | | | | Peter, I'm currently at the Fort Peck Tribal Court 1st Annual Human Trafficking Conference to discuss strategies to stop human trafficking and how to combat the Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women, Girls, and Two-Spirit People crisis, so I thought I'd send out this important message. As a tenacious advocate for survivors of human trafficking, I cofounded the Yellowstone County Area Human Trafficking Task Force, the largest such task force in Montana. I have secured funding from the Montana Legislature for additional state agents to investigate human trafficking crimes, co-authored bills to strengthen laws on human trafficking, participated in national committees developing policy on crimes of human trafficking and child sexual abuse material, often referred to as child pornography, and, in 2020, I was the lone Montanan invited to attend the White House Summit on Human Trafficking. It's safe to say I know what I'm talking about when it comes to stopping human trafficking. Now, I'm not sure I can say the same thing for my opponent, Matt Rosendale. | WATCH: Penny Ronning fights human traffickers and WINS | As a state legislator, Matt Rosendale was one of only 7 state senators to vote against strengthening Montana’s human trafficking laws by allowing survivors an affirmative defense, deeming a survivor's past sexual behavior generally inadmissible, and requiring perpetrators to register as sex offenders. It gets worse. In 2015, Rosendale voted against expanding unemployment insurance availability for survivors of domestic violence. In 2011, Rosendale voted against funding an expansion of a sex crime survivor notification system that tells survivors when their perpetrator gets out of prison. The system would have encompassed 8,400 more felons. ALL Montanans deserve a Congress member who cares more about protecting THEM - not human traffickers and sex offenders. body:
We still have some big shoes to fill so I wanted to make sure you caught Saturday’s email.

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this 🙏
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60843345:65p2WQVbN:m:1:3317145305:E2C4C59268D1F1A7CB99F3E30D6D3A14:r "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60843345:65p2WQVbN:m:1:3317145305:E2C4C59268D1F1A7CB99F3E30D6D3A14:r "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60843345:65p2WQVbN:m:1:3317145305:E2C4C59268D1F1A7CB99F3E30D6D3A14:r "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60843345:65p2WQVbN:m:1:3317145305:E2C4C59268D1F1A7CB99F3E30D6D3A14:r "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60843345:65p2WQVbN:m:1:3317145305:E2C4C59268D1F1A7CB99F3E30D6D3A14:r "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60843345:65p2WQVbN:m:1:3317145305:E2C4C59268D1F1A7CB99F3E30D6D3A14:r "I hope
you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60843345:65p2WQVbN:m:1:3317145305:E2C4C59268D1F1A7CB99F3E30D6D3A14:r "I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio

subject: Spotlight: Weekly focus on the special interests holding back our state
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/borisbenandms-8132508?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
---
|
# How solar increases your electricity bill
---
| Why are electricity prices rising so fast?

Over the past quarter century, electricity prices in America have increased by an average of 1.8 percent per year. In January 2022, both Entergy and Mississippi Power increased their rates by $7.81 per month and $5.27 per month respectively, affecting over half a million Mississippi residents.

According to Mississippi’s Public Service Commissioner for the Central District, Brent Bailey, this price hike was due to the volatility of natural gas prices. But blaming rises in the price of natural gas also overlooks the role that solar energy is playing in power price increases.

We already know from research produced by the University of Chicago that setting renewable energy production targets in a state pushes up the price of power.

But our state, thankfully, does not have those types of targets. So how come renewables are pushing up the price of electricity in Mississippi?

It has a lot to do with the bureaucratic way in which energy prices are set in our state.

In a properly functioning market, a company has an incentive to keep the cost of producing things down so that they can set their prices low and still make a margin. The trouble is that the power industry in our state, as across much of America, is a near monopoly. Entergy, for example, supplies power to 45 counties and 461,000 customers. It’s not just a near monopoly in those parts of the state it covers, it is a vertically integrated monopoly, meaning that it not only produces the power but distributes it. It would be a little bit like Krogers also owning the farms and food processing plants used to stock its shelves.

The price that Entergy insists that you pay is not an amount decided by free and fair competition. It’s the amount that the Public Service Commission allows them to charge you.

In a free market, the price of a product is whatever customers are willing to pay. When a price is set by the government and corporate bureaucrats, they calculate it on a cost-plus basis. That is to say, they work out what it costs them to produce it, and then add on their margin of around 10 percent (the percentage can fluctuate). This automatically removes the incentive to produce more efficiently.

This is precisely what happened when $7 billion was spent on the disastrous Kemper county ‘clean coal’ initiative. In 2014, Entergy customers who used 1,000 kWh per month saw a 2.6% rise in their utility bills to allow the producer to claw back some of the costs.

Something similar is happening with solar.

We are invited to feel good every time the energy producers announce another solar project. Did they tell you you would be paying extra for it?

The recently lauded Sunflower County solar project will add an additional $1.38 to your bill every month. That’s $16.56 a year, which might not sound like much, but add in the other renewable schemes, as it soon becomes quite a cost.

According to some estimates, the MS Solar, Pearl River Solar, Wildflower, Lowndes County, Delta’s Edge and Cane Creek solar projects alone could add something like $116 to each customer's annual bill.

The average electric payment of a Mississippi resident is $1,583/year. What this means is that solar farms in just the past three years have caused a 7 percent increase in utility payments.

The way that electricity prices are set in our state – bureaucratic negotiations between government and corporations on a cost-plus basis – more or less guarantees that customers get bad value for money.

Far from encouraging energy producers to keep costs down, if the producers are able to add a 10 percent margin to their cost base, they weirdly have an incentive to increase costs. Why should they care if solar farms are not the cheapest way to power your home?

Cost plus 10 percent gives producers an incentive to 'go green.' But green energy is more expensive than producing power by burning oil, gas and coal. Perhaps if the Public Service Commission really acted in the consumer interests, it would pass on the cost of renewables to the energy company shareholders?

**_Michelle Brodsky writes about energy policy at the Mississippi Center for Public Policy._**

If you haven’t had the chance to watch our roundtable discussion, you can view it [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48073949/356831008/-803653937?v=_J2RHyF9uSs&refcode=em_220720_WHroundtable&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220720_WHroundtable&refcode2=041e640d-4508-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDFlNjQwZC00NTA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2PPYEatF6tnUI7r5ax-UU7UR4nfjn1b7XRkJ20yDCOo=&emci=0ffa1ffc-dc06-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=041e640d-4508-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=17998091). body:

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWtL-RYhNM

Friend of Life,

This is one of the most surreal
moments I've ever experienced.

After decades of marching,
advocating, and praying, Roe v. Wade is finally finished, the
false "constitutional right" to kill a preborn child has been
erased by the United States Supreme Court.

We are experiencing a truly
historic victory for life!

I rejoice alongside you for the
lives that will be saved due to the reversal of this horrific
decision. However, this victory is just the beginning.

Our work to transform our culture
and make abortion unthinkable is just getting started.

Abortion advocates are in an
uproar, pushing lies that women will die, life-saving medical
care will be eliminated, and the reversal of Roe will lead us
back to the "Dark Ages."

Remember, abortion is still legal
and even subsidized in many states. The killing of preborn babies
has not stopped.

We are now fighting an uphill
battle against an onslaught of disinformation and deceit - the
same lies that led to the senseless killing of 63 million
innocent children.

The pro-life movement is facing
its most critical moment in history.

In order to keep up our momentum
for life, we need your financial support.

Specifically, I am looking for 50
people who want to protect babies from abortion to step forward
and make a $30 gift before midnight tonight. This will enable us
to reach 50,000 moms and dads with the truth they need to choose
life. Donate here: https://give.liveaction.org

There is no doubt about it: the
goal of the abortion lobby is to enshrine the "right" to kill a
child through abortion in federal law. Now that they have failed
in the Supreme Court, we will see more efforts than ever before
to pass a national law forcing abortion on every community.

Pro-abortion activists are hoping
we call it victory and walk away from the fight. But we will not
make that mistake.

We must ensure that pro-life
states, like Oklahoma, Mississippi, Texas, and dozens of others
can continue to enact laws protecting preborn babies. We must
shut down abortion facilities that are endangering the lives of
women and putting to death innocent children-and we must continue
the groundwork to build a Culture of Life in states like
California, New York, and Illinois where abortion-on-demand is
the law of the land.

No one has the right to
intentionally kill an innocent human being. Our human rights, the
first among them the right to life, are inherent and given to us
by God. Governments exist to protect those rights.

Please stand with us to build a
culture that cherishes every human life, starting with our
precious preborn children. Make your gift right now to ensure
that abortion dies with Roe: https://give.liveaction.org

People can change, and they
change their hearts and minds when they are presented with the
