body:
One of the hardest parts about running for office is asking people for money. No one really likes it.

Friends -
One of the hardest parts about running for office is asking people for money. No one really likes it.
But California is a large state, our races are expensive, and we have to keep it Blue in 2022.
So today we have to ask for money. It’s just what we have to do:
[**Can you please use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford? We will put your donation right to work re-electing Gavin Newsom, turn out voters who will pass the constitutional amendment protecting abortion, and keeping California blue.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-july22?refcode=em-220720-1-30&refcode2=893_4767699_icRc8U&akid=893%2E4767699%2EicRc8U)
Re-elect Gavin Newsom.
Turn out as many Democrats as we can.
Push Democrats in close races over the top.
Turn out voters who will pass a constitutional amendment protecting abortion.
Continue our progress for four more years.
That’s what we’re going to do with the donations we receive today. So please:
[**Contribute $3 or whatever you can afford to Gavin Newsom’s re-election campaign today. It all adds up when we’re all chipping in.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-july22?refcode=em-220720-1-30&refcode2=893_4767699_icRc8U&akid=893%2E4767699%2EicRc8U)
[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-july22?refcode=em-220720-1-30&refcode2=893_4767699_icRc8U&akid=893%2E4767699%2EicRc8U)
Thank you,
Team Newsom

clean_body: | | | | In the wake of the Supreme Court's disastrous decision to rip away a woman's right to make her own health care decisions, abortion is already being criminalized in states nationwide. Authorities in states that pass laws that criminalize abortion could go even further by weaponizing a woman's private information. Everything from researching birth control online to bringing a phone to the doctor's office or entering information into a period tracking app could be used as evidence to prosecute them. It's clear that protecting the right to online privacy has become a life or death matter in the United States. And believe it or not, it gets worse. This should alarm us all.Every digital record could be weaponized to control women's bodies and criminalize people for seeking reproductive care. We need to do everything in our power to ensure that reproductive rights are protected now and into the future. Reproductive health care, including abortion, is a personal health decision. Americans should be free to live their lives and make these personal decisions free of government intrusion. We must fight this injustice from every angle. No one should choose between putting dinner on the table and picking up their prescription drugs.
No one should have to work two or three jobs, let alone do so and _still_ struggle to send their kids to college or afford a down payment on a home.
No one should be priced out of the American Dream.

Trudy Busch Valentine is running for Senate to give everyone a shot at achieving their American Dream.**She'll work night and day to make that a reality – and she has a plan to get it done.**

Team — We woke up today with energy and optimism. Change is in the air. While the votes continue to be counted — because _in Maryland_ , we respect everyone’s right to have their vote counted — we feel very good about the position we’re in. Yesterday, Marylanders voted to end the broken politics and the divisiveness that have left too many people behind. Marylanders voted for new ideas, new life experiences, a new approach to leadership and a direction for our state. **Marylanders voted to become a state where _we leave no one behind._** A year ago, there were many who believed winning wasn’t possible. But you believed... you got involved... you worked tirelessly to _make it happen_. Thousands of volunteers made hundreds of thousands of calls and door-knocks, reaching nearly two million Marylanders. A broad coalition of everyday Marylanders – from veterans, to teachers, to environmentalists to small business owners – took to their communities and encouraged their neighbors to vote for a better future. A truly grassroots, people-powered campaign. And we’re just getting started. While we are excited, and humbled, by the outpouring of support from Democrats yesterday — we should also take notice that the Republicans have chosen their nominee. The Republicans nominated Donald Trump’s choice for Maryland Governor, a member of the MAGA movement who made a name for himself by tearing people apart. He participated in the insurrection of our democracy on January 6th, and would bring that same toxic and divisive approach to Annapolis – tearing down the values we hold dear, like a woman’s right to choose, common sense gun laws and the importance of strong public schools. Maryland is not Trump Country. _That is not who we are._ But, all of it means that the stakes have never been higher. So, as we await the final results, let’s all recharge our batteries, feel proud of the work we’ve done — and get ready for the fight ahead. Elevate, Wes Moore | | Wes Moore is a combat veteran, a former small business owner, and the former CEO of a leading non-profit. Wes believes no matter where you start in life, you deserve an equal opportunity to succeed. He’s running to become Governor of Maryland and flip this state blue for the first time in 8 years. And we need your help to do it.

clean_body: | = Team — We woke up today with energy and optimism. Change is in the air. While the votes continue to be counted — because in Maryland , we respect everyone’s right to have their vote counted — we feel very good about the position we’re in. Yesterday, Marylanders voted to end the broken politics and the divisiveness that have left too many people behind. Marylanders voted for new ideas, new life experiences, a new approach to leadership and a direction for our state. Marylanders voted to become a state where we leave no one behind. A year ago, there were many who believed winning wasn’t possible. But you believed... you got involved... you worked tirelessly to make it happen. Thousands of volunteers made hundreds of thousands of calls and door-knocks, reaching nearly two million Marylanders. A broad coalition of everyday Marylanders – from veterans, to teachers, to environmentalists to small business owners – took to their communities and encouraged their neighbors to vote for a better future. A truly grassroots, people-powered campaign. And we’re just getting started. While we are excited, and humbled, by the outpouring of support from Democrats yesterday — we should also take notice that the Republicans have chosen their nominee. The Republicans nominated Donald Trump’s choice for Maryland Governor, a member of the MAGA movement who made a name for himself by tearing people apart. He participated in the insurrection of our democracy on January 6th, and would bring that same toxic and divisive approach to Annapolis – tearing down the values we hold dear, like a woman’s right to choose, common sense gun laws and the importance of strong public schools. Maryland is not Trump Country. That is not who we are. But, all of it means that the stakes have never been higher. So, as we await the final results, let’s all recharge our batteries, feel proud of the work we’ve done — and get ready for the fight ahead. Elevate, Wes Moore | | Wes Moore is a combat veteran, a former small business owner, and the former CEO of a leading non-profit. The U.S. military produces the world’s greatest leaders, and that’s why I’m proud to support fellow veteran Hung Cao for Congress. Hung is living proof of the American Dream, Peter. That’s why Hung attended the Naval Academy and went on to serve in the U.S. Navy for 25 years. He served alongside special forces, performed dangerous dives, and put his life on the line for our great country. I know he’ll be an incredible conservative leader in Congress, but right now, he needs your help. Then, after my career in national security, witnessing the harm of Donald Trump’s administration, and watching the events of January 6th, 2021, I knew I needed to step up again.
Knowing my father was a combat veteran and watching him represent our district in Congress with integrity were formative experiences that influenced the course of my life. **More than anything else, my father was able to make a difference in the lives of hardworking families in our communities. _That is what I most want to do now._**

The Secretary of State, working with clerks, presides over all of this. That’s why we need a fair, thoughtful leader like Jocelyn doing the job.

Mississippi at a Girl Scouts national conference.

So they changed their travel plans, leaving me behind at the wrong
airport.

Do you think I let them stop me? Certainly not. I got on a plane for the
first time in my life and flew to Arizona by myself. I made it to the
conference and represented my state with pride.

Here is what that moment taught me: We will inevitably face people who try

body:
https://jaredforflorida.com/ [https://jaredforflorida.com/]
Dear Friend,
My name is Jared Moskowitz and I’m running for Congress because, quite frankly, I am scared for our country’s future. Democracy is under attack, and I want to thank you for protecting our future by casting a ballot in the Primary Election.
Broward and Palm Beach Counties deserve a leader who is ready to stand up for our Democratic values, fight back against the GOP’s dangerous agenda, and ensure that the government meets its sacred obligations to our community.
Government failed us when 17 people were murdered at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School, my alma mater in Parkland. I was a State Representative at the time and while grieving with the devastated families, I committed to channeling anguish into action.
In the days that followed, I led the charge to stand up to the NRA and pass the most comprehensive gun violence prevention, mental health, and school safety legislation ever enacted in our state. Among other provisions, our bill raised the minimum age to buy a weapon to 21 and implemented “Red Flag” laws, which have been used over 8,000 times since the law was passed to keep guns away from dangerous people.
After bringing together Democrats and Republicans to pass that law, I became Florida’s Director of Emergency Management. During the pandemic, I oversaw the distribution of vaccines and personal protective equipment for frontline workers and the most vulnerable members of our community. I did everything in my power to save lives and keep us safe.
Now, I am proud to serve as a Democrat on the Broward County Commission. Over nearly two decades in public service, I have always sought to bring Democratic values to everything I do. That’s why my campaign for Congress has been endorsed by Hillary Clinton and more than 100 Democratic elected officials and organizations , including dozens of Democratic state legislators, and unions representing teachers, nurses, firefighters, law enforcement officers, and others.
With the Supreme Court ruling overturning Roe V. Wade, Congress must pass the right to an abortion into law and bypass the filibuster to get it through the Senate. I’ll work hard to enact sweeping gun violence prevention measures like an assault weapons ban, make our community more affordable, protect Social Security and Medicare, and safeguard our environment. Most importantly, I will defend American democracy from those seeking to subvert free and fair elections and upend the rule of law.
I’m asking for your support. Whether you vote by mail, during Early Voting, or on Election Day, I hope that you will grant me the privilege of serving you in the House of Representatives.
Thank you,
Jared Moskowitz
Democrat for Congress, FL-23
Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
Jared Moskowitz for Congress
PO Box 8784
Coral Springs, FL 33065
United States

body:
I hope you’ll read Anastasia’s story and join me in keeping up the fight to make the world a little bit better each day. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48092501/356906487/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ6V_ART_E_20220720_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjI5YzFmZi04MDA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=db3wq21h4FexbRdASChJQU7rUb1qSruf1g4IryW3e0k=&emci=a68bb7de-6508-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=c229c1ff-8008-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)
---
Our Team Warren family has lost a bright light — Anastasia Golovashkina passed away this week after a battle with cancer. Anastasia served as the social media director for our presidential campaign starting in June of 2019. She was responsible for the many pieces that most likely made you laugh, learn something about policies like the two-cent wealth tax, or feel inspired and seen by the campaign we were building. Just two weeks after beginning on the job, she received her glioblastoma diagnosis. Even with this devastating news, she still chose to bring her energy, her heart, and her thoughtfulness to our campaign, and she fought hard for what she believed in in order to make the world better for everyone. She was a kind and brilliant member of our team — and I am deeply, deeply heartbroken. [_**Anastasia was great at so many things. One exceptional talent she had was telling stories — including her own. I hope you’ll read her story and learn about her courage, grace, and fighting spirit as she faced glioblastoma and navigated the American healthcare system in the process (and if you can’t read it right now, please consider bookmarking it for later).**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48092502/356906488/-639218751?refcode=EMZ6V_ART_E_20220720_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjI5YzFmZi04MDA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=db3wq21h4FexbRdASChJQU7rUb1qSruf1g4IryW3e0k=&emci=a68bb7de-6508-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=c229c1ff-8008-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48092503/356906489/-639218751?refcode=EMZ6V_ART_E_20220720_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjI5YzFmZi04MDA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=db3wq21h4FexbRdASChJQU7rUb1qSruf1g4IryW3e0k=&emci=a68bb7de-6508-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=c229c1ff-8008-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) | [READ NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48092504/356906490/-639218751?refcode=EMZ6V_ART_E_20220720_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjI5YzFmZi04MDA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=db3wq21h4FexbRdASChJQU7rUb1qSruf1g4IryW3e0k=&emci=a68bb7de-6508-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=c229c1ff-8008-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)
---
Campaigns — working in politics — are tough. It’s the people you meet along the way, the people like Anastasia, who make this all worth it. She lived her values and led with kindness and a fierce optimism to see the world as it should be.
I hope you’ll read her story and join me in committing to keep up the fight to make the world a little bit better each day — just as Anastasia did. Whether that’s through speaking out on the injustices of the world (like our healthcare system), putting in the work to make others feel seen, or simply by offering a friend a hug, sending them a funny joke, or giving them a call to catch up.
Thanks for reading,
Elizabeth

clean_body: I hope you’ll read Anastasia’s story and join me in keeping up the fight to make the world a little bit better each day. | | | Our Team Warren family has lost a bright light — Anastasia Golovashkina passed away this week after a battle with cancer. Anastasia served as the social media director for our presidential campaign starting in June of 2019. She was responsible for the many pieces that most likely made you laugh, learn something about policies like the two-cent wealth tax, or feel inspired and seen by the campaign we were building. Just two weeks after beginning on the job, she received her glioblastoma diagnosis. Even with this devastating news, she still chose to bring her energy, her heart, and her thoughtfulness to our campaign, and she fought hard for what she believed in in order to make the world better for everyone. She was a kind and brilliant member of our team — and I am deeply, deeply heartbroken. | Campaigns — working in politics — are tough. It’s the people you meet along the way, the people like Anastasia, who make this all worth it. She lived her values and led with kindness and a fierce optimism to see the world as it should be. I hope you’ll read her story and join me in committing to keep up the fight to make the world a little bit better each day — just as Anastasia did. Whether that’s through speaking out on the injustices of the world (like our healthcare system), putting in the work to make others feel seen, or simply by offering a friend a hug, sending them a funny joke, or giving them a call to catch up. Thanks for reading, Elizabeth | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

This workshop will focus on untangling the complex process of Oregon’s legislative sessions in a way that makes sense to folks beginning their foray into climate organizing. The training aims to educate youth passionate about our environment on the different levels and moving parts throughout Oregon’s legislature, previous climate victories achieved through the legislative process in Oregon, and how those policies were successfully brought to light. Finally, the course will make attendees aware about the important climate measures and environmental champions on our ballots this November. Stay tuned for more information on the next two courses: **“Winning Elections 101”** and**“Canvassing 101,”** which will take place on the last Wednesday of August and September respectively. We hope to see you there!_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48092531/356906575/1534396290?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY2YWYzNGEyLTgxMDgtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=scOUTs8rB-_C5wBz_XQSVJXK0Gwn-jQBfrsy4nc-QtA=&emci=485731b5-6c08-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=66af34a2-8108-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)

Many candidates and organizations will come to you asking for money to fund their efforts. Peter, let me tell you: No other organization is as nimble or as far-reaching in mission as ours, and no other organization has yielded so many results so quickly. That's what makes Advancing American Freedom unique — and it's why I founded the organization. I have a panoramic view of what drives policy from my experience in Congress, as Governor of Indiana, and in the White House as Vice President of the United States. And I have learned that conservatives NEED a group like AAF. And, Peter, AAF needs you. That means we can't talk to voters daily and set the record straight about the barrage of false attack ads that are currently airing. Unfortunately, we're already falling short again this week, and without your immediate help - we're going to have to cut our advertising budget again. Peter, Abortion remains legal and safe in Pennsylvania, but now that the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , abortion rights are under attack across the country. We are in a fight to make sure every person has the freedom to access the health care they need and control their own bodies, and the stakes have never been higher.

Abortion is on the ballot this November, but many people need help right away to ensure the power to make medical decisions about their own lives remains an option. **[So today, will you join me in supporting abortion funds across the country who are working to ensure people have the resources the make their own decisions about their health care?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48085486/356878637/-1348740862?refcode=em22_220720_oped_fndd_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220720_oped_fndd_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODNjY2U5OC02NjA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OpSxxzxumwbQrJwM54R43sDxBLlCkn-1G41I1VKSebc=)** As a physician in Philadelphia teaching hospitals for over 20 years, I’ve cared for patients making incredibly difficult decisions about their pregnancies, and I can tell you firsthand that there is no place in those decisions for a politician in Harrisburg or Washington, D.C.

Today, in states with extreme anti-abortion laws, people are being denied the opportunity to make these deeply personal health care decisions for themselves and, in some places, doctors face threats of prosecution for caring for their patients.

Without the protections of _Roe_ , some states have already made abortion illegal in all cases. And in states where it is still legal, they are working overtime to do all they can to restrict access to abortion care. **[Abortion access should not be based on ZIP code, income level, flexibility and resources to travel to another state. Will you chip in to support abortion funds across the nation now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48085487/356878638/-1348740862?refcode=em22_220720_oped_fndd_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220720_oped_fndd_gq_act___va_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODNjY2U5OC02NjA4LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OpSxxzxumwbQrJwM54R43sDxBLlCkn-1G41I1VKSebc=)**

But we cannot stop there. We have a critical election coming up this November and it’s never been more important to make your voice heard.

He even said that if he was elected Governor, he would make abortion a crime and throw doctors in jail for performing them. And he could have a GOP-led Legislature that could put that bill on his desk.
But , I’ve always been vocal about being pro-choice — and Nan and I will continue defending reproductive freedom and abortion access as the next governors of Ohio and Pennsylvania. I will use my veto pen to block any legislation that restricts abortion access and I will make sure that all of our rights are protected.

---
| _"If ever a time should come, when vain and aspiring men shall possess the highest seats in Government, our country will stand in need of its experienced patriots to prevent its ruin." _
\- Samuel Adams _ _
---
| Dear Fellow Patriot, What an ADVENTURE the last six months has been! Campaigning on a Republican ticket for the U.S. Senate seat in a predominantly blue state was not an easy task. I thought being a Marine was the hardest thing I have ever done, and then I ran for office! The swamp doesn't begin when you get to D.C., it starts on day one when you declare your candidacy.

Fighting for this beautiful state is one of the most rewarding jobs I have ever had, not just the last six months, but the last two years since the lock downs began. Fortunately, we have a lot of success to report.

In a pool of 23 Candidates, we took 3rd place and amassed over 500,000 votes. We consider that a huge victory and many political advisors and strategists feel the same way. This victory is evidence to all of us of what's possible when we rely on God and red, white, and blue Patriots. We are on a path to win many seats in California by putting the Constitution first. Don't worry, I'm a Marine, I have never surrendered and I wont start now. My family and this organization will continue to fight for you and yours. I'm still the man dedicated to restoring the American spirit, personal freedom, and parental rights. But I can't do this without you.

I want you to know - we are teaming up with some amazing patriots to continue our efforts and activism with 1776 Forever Free. We are creating a Coalition of grass-root organizations that have power, influence and most importantly, the interest of the people, no egos and no evil agenda; pure hearted patriots willing and able to make a change. This coalition will be more unique and diverse than any you have ever seen run by some of the biggest organizations in California that you will recognize and know with the sole mission of getting everyone in this state that believes in the Constitution on the same page.

Its very clear that there are statewide organizations that claim to believe in grassroots interests, but they really have their own interests in mind. This epidemic is going on in cities and towns around the nation where organizations pose to be for "We the People," but they are actually part of the establishment and "We the RHINOS".

1776 Forever Free has positioned itself the last three years to be at the head of this fight and the only one to really take the helm. The Coalition that we are forming is one of the many initiatives that we are pushing forward to change this state and the nation. We must act NOW to save our state and our country, but we cannot do it without your help.

We would not be in this strong position without the financial generosity of so many fed-up Californians and concerned Americans. However, we all have to do more with our TIME, HANDS and MONEY. We ask for your help and support again with your generous donations, volunteer work, and prayers!

We have a clear conservative, constitutional vision and we have an opportunity to defeat the elite Democratic machine controlled by Biden, Kamala, Pelosi, and Adolf Newsom.

I cannot fight on my own! It's going to take all of us! With your support I am confident that we can work with some of the most elite patriots to create that Red-White-Blue, Constitutional wave we all crave across this State. Thank you for your generosity. God Bless and Semper Fi.

Dr. Cordie Williams
USMC Veteran
Founder of 1776 Forever Free

Peter,

The news last week for our campaign was a mixed bag.

While we raised the most money last quarter of any non-incumbent Republican running for the Senate in the country, **our opponent raised $11 million more than us and has three times as much money in the bank.**

That's why I think it's sad he emails far-Left donors and _**falsely warns**_ them he may have to take his ads off TV because he doesn't have enough money to compete.

**In reality, our campaign is the one that cannot keep up with his record-setting fundraising machine of out-of-state money.**

Right now, we're having to make tough decisions about our advertising budget because we fell short of our fundraising goal last week. That means we can't talk to voters daily and set the record straight about the barrage of false attack ads that are currently airing.

Unfortunately, we're already falling short again this week, and without your immediate help - we're going to have to cut our advertising budget again.

With 111 days until Election Day, time is not on our side. In fact, in just 33 days, voters will be able to begin requesting absentee ballots.

| | Fellow American,

When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”

_I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House._

In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. **But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in.**

Fellow patriot,

As a conservative, I know you’ll appreciate this. **History suggests that Republicans will take back the majority in the House in this year's midterm elections** but we have one problem; the Left has never controlled the media quite like they do today.

To pull this off, we’ll need a team effort from conservatives everywhere, including you Fellow patriot. That’s why I need you to know about my fellow Texan, a conservative running for Congress, Monica De La Cruz. **[If there’s ever been a candidate that deserves your support in this election, it’s Monica](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=4e23c15df2fa487c81c3bc9c3043b0e2&_e=N1FW0ITgmVAJcydnD-g50VtcamFBmS10ow1udChbdvjB6rM5-dNStzFp99MDsR_hIxiNyyyBRXEvkFMQAiL6gXtyykOVl4xgXC2r1FNIQNwzGu_PGGcyafz4DB1RLhFe8mOt2PQNkv0gmiIiqGarYfv-tzb7-MwpgJeUCkrAuB8ZHX6Y-uDhajnY68kRHs_Hs2ZGT5nAsxYdt9OWRJBjPvDqeh1l8EiOklNygHJm0WZGS5DXngFc7Xd24yEEg3tXvxyptsHh53WyYmNfJp8vWpfa8uLrMbOaThh801fec11iTPLjStDFlEWT8MGa8SXU4Qsp0iNrw6B_Uy6kojg4wYAp26n-ZL-GjWOIxKl25USZext2k4oQlpXjmqa3cUbSa6jRa5q20h7nHVpCquulPzg0lsvtOHUpMr_T7kIM0cVeX6xO2tZykDUuk93UnSKp3ujis1yfgoZOcSgPj_RWgntL3B9_ZigWxm5n5UjDYQIXp6Dr4Qn_DwNWwiFF6LTBMLi_GOjjG6iHJf_W3khnkg%3D%3D)**.

Fellow American,

The news last week for our campaign was a mixed bag.

While we raised the most money last quarter of any non-incumbent Republican running for the Senate in the country, **our opponent raised $11 million more than us and has three times as much money in the bank.**

body:

|
Fellow Patriots and Supporters:

We are planning on knocking on doors in Waunakee, the Beloit area, Monroe, and Reedsburg on Saturday. We will have coordinators in each area to meet you. Contact Kyle Hudson at [kyle@charitybarryforcongress.com](mailto:kyle@charitybarryforcongress.com) if you can participate. You will be given information on where to meet in each area. Personal contact with voters has been shown to be the most effective method of reaching voters. But I cannot do this alone.

If you cannot knock on doors Saturday but are willing to knock on doors in your neighborhood or just drop literature off at houses on your street please contact us. We will get our literature out to you. We need yard signs out on major streets also. Email us and one of my volunteers will drop off the sign.

We can win this and unseat Mark Pocan! But to win a race like this one, it is going to take time, effort, and sacrifice on the part of each and every one of us!

Thank You!

Charity Barry

body:
We need a candidate who can take back the Office of Secretary of State from the Democrats. I am ready! | | | |
---
| | Finchem Can't Speak for Himself and Hides Behind Trump's Endorsement
---
| | I find it laughable that after 12 years of being recognized by almost every credible group as one of the strongest conservatives and being labeled a “vote suppressor” and "racist" by the left-wing media and the democrats I am now preposterously being lumped in with the left -- it would be amusing if it wasn't so pathetic. As we have seen, just because someone says something does not make it so. For example, imagine my surprise when I learned I was a called a “never Trumper” who is friends with the “radical left.” This is nothing more than a desperate attempt to hide the fact that I am the strongest candidate in this race and the only one who can beat Adrian Fontes in November. I am proud of my conservative record and think it is worth pointing out a couple of differences between me and Mark Finchem. First, the obvious. By every objective standard, my record of conservatism far exceeds his. While he was pushing for higher taxes, I was fighting to cut taxes. Just a few weeks ago I was the only candidate in this race who did not vote with the democrats and Governor Ducey to pass the largest spending budget in state history. Mark didn’t hesitate to support the democrat-backed budget. Who is the real RINO? While he was pushing to eliminate the Electoral College with his National Popular Vote (NPV) scheme, which would have given us President Hillary Clinton, I was fighting to kill NPV. I could go on, but suffice it to say, I’ll put my conservative record up against his every day of the week. But since we are running for Secretary of State, I think it’s important to focus on election integrity and what each of us has done to advance this issue in Arizona. I wrote the law to ban ballot harvesting. I also wrote the law to clean up our vote-by-mail rolls. For that matter, I have actually written most of the Republican election integrity reforms in the last decade. He and my other opponent not only voted for my bills, they run on them. His record..? He told voters he would decertify the 2020 presidential election and then never even introduced legislation to do it. President Trump is free to endorse Mark - for a second time in this primary. However, that does not make him the best choice. I’m confident I will prevail on August 2nd because Republican voters want a proven conservative fighting and winning for them as Secretary of State - not a pretender like Mark Finchem. If you want a conservative leader for Secretary of State, Please vote _Michelle Ugenti-Rita in the upcoming Republican Primary for Secretary of State!_

name: Stacey Abrams
subject: I need your help to fight against Brian Kemp’s attack on our reproductive rights.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

Today, Brian Kemp’s extreme and dangerous bill — which makes abortion care
a crime after six weeks of pregnancy, before many women even know they’re
pregnant — was finalized by the courts and is now the law of the land in
Georgia.

This decision bans access to abortion care at 6 weeks and sends a clear
and terrifying message to Georgia women — the freedom to determine if,
when and how to start or grow a family is on the line — and on the ballot.

There is no other way to put it: the person who took an oath to protect us
just made it even more dangerous to be a woman in our state.

Kemp’s callous decision to put politics above women’s healthcare needs
endangers the lives of all women and their families and it will exacerbate
crises in our state.

Under Kemp, Georgia is at or near the bottom on nearly every health care
measure — from doctor and nursing shortages, to maternal and infant
deaths, to the shuttering of three hospitals during the pandemic.

This is outrageous. We deserve better and we must fight back.

As Georgia’s next governor, I will defend a woman’s right to choose,
support reproductive health care with a comprehensive plan for Georgia’s
women in the aftermath of Kemp’s disastrous bill and protect the rights of
all.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1525?refcode=sa_em_220720_B3_Ban_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1079%2E1862389%2EwBC36q ]But first, I need your help to win in November so I can take office and
take action. Can I count on you to power our fight with your
first donation
today, Derek?

Derek, as a
legislator, as a woman and as a Georgian, I have spent my career fighting
for reproductive justice. I defeated a bill that would have injected
racial division into medical decisions. I challenged bills that banned
insurance coverage for abortion. I battled those who sought to limit a
woman’s right to control her body – including the six week ban that will
govern the lives of Georgians.

As governor, I will use my office to stop further attacks on women’s
rights in their tracks.

But first, we must stand together — women, advocates, reproductive justice
activists, the LGBTQ+ community, health care providers, allies and all in
our state who will not be still or silent while we are under attack. We
must continue the fight for safe access to the reproductive health care we
need and deserve.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1525?refcode=sa_em_220720_B3_Ban_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=1079%2E1862389%2EwBC36q ]This will not be easy, but together we can do it,
Derek. Please, if you are able,
will you make a donation to my campaign so that we can stand up for
reproductive rights and pursue reproductive justice?

Derek, in the
days ahead, remember that we are not alone. Believe in our ability to
protect one another. Lean into our capacity to defend our rights in the
streets and at the ballot box.

And know that together, if we unite, we can fight for good.

Stacey

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1525?refcode=sa_em_220720_B3_Ban_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=1079%2E1862389%2EwBC36q ]DONATE

##
20 July 22

**THANK YOU for your support, your prayers and your vote!**

While we're excited to be 933 votes ahead, the election has not yet been called. In Maryland, mail-in ballots are permitted to arrive two days after the election and then the mail-in counting begins. Given the large number of mail-in ballots, we may not know the results for several more days. So keep praying for a victory for the people of District 4.

As we've shared, no Republican candidate has campaigned so extensively in Prince George's County as Jeff Warner in at least 35 years!
Here are some of our victories:
* 7,043 homes visited in 3.5 months
* 6,869 calls made to voters reaching 2,834 voters
* 18,653 voters reached via 472,108 texts
* Approximately 800 voters reached through Sign Waiving at busy intersections
* Innumerable prayers
* Jeff Warner has been the only Republican candidate at several public events

This is the power of teamwork!
And the Best Is Yet To Come!

Assuming our victory is confirmed, we need more volunteers, more donations and more prayers.
Join our winning team and movement.

We are humbled by your support and Phase II begins now. In 15 weeks, we'll know the results of the General Election. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=1632dcd718&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

name: Matt Braynard
subject: what you don't know about Joe Kent
body:
Hi,
I'm glad to be one of the people helping out Joe's campaign, and I want to tell you one reason why Joe Kent's race is much more difficult than any other primary in the country.
And this reason is in addition to the challenges of running against an incumbent RINO with millions in establishment dollars or the millions in dark money propping up spoiler candidates put in the race to attack Joe and split the vote.
What makes Joe Kent's race even more difficult is that Washington State automatically mails a ballot to every voter and, as a result, a lot more people vote in this primary than in primaries in any other state.
Will you please help us overcome these challenges with a contribution today at [https://www.joekentforcongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/ci6Ma4IeIur892a7P892YqHIHA/iyZ0Cw4R17634llmbg5ZzhPA)?
To put it in real numbers, while other primaries around the country are decided by as few as 50,000 voters, we are expecting 200,000 voters to cast ballots in our primary.
This means we have to mail, call, text, and deliver digital ads to a much larger audience, and that costs a lot more. Instead of sending out 25,000 pieces of mail, we have to send out 100,000.
And in these final weeks of the campaign, we are spending funds as quickly as they are coming in.
We're grateful for the donations that have allowed us to go this far, and I'm making a personal request that you dig deep and give again so we can prevail against the America Last establishment that desperately needs Joe to lose.
Please, help us finish the fight at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/txktccwMLpzqKYbbcuktFw/iyZ0Cw4R17634llmbg5ZzhPA).
Thank you,

Matt Braynard
PS - Because the Washington State mails every voter a ballot and so many people vote, the cost of this campaign is four times higher than a typical congressional campaign. Please help us even the odds by contributing at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/txktccwMLpzqKYbbcuktFw/iyZ0Cw4R17634llmbg5ZzhPA).

Kirsten Engel has been a fierce advocate for Arizona families in the State Legislature. As an environmental attorney, she understands the climate crisis we are facing and the need to protect our state's resources. When it comes to energy and water, she is the expert we need advocating for Arizona.
Kirsten is a champion for our public schools — as an educator, mother, and policy maker, we have seen her show up and fight to restore funding for our children's education.
Over the course of this campaign, Kirsten Engel has put Arizonans at the forefront. She listens, she shows up, and she is doing the work.
I believe Kirsten has what it takes to win this seat and advocate for you.
